sqlMap.select: SELECT SN ,USERID ,USERNAME ,PASSWORD ,MANAGEGROUP ,'' STARTDATE ,'' ENDDATE FROM EG_USERINFO WHERE USERID = #userid# AND PASSWORD = #password# LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) AS DEVICECOUNT , SUM(C.cleancount) AS CLEANCOUNT , SUM(C.cleancount) * 52 / 1000000 AS CO2VALUE , SUM(C.cleancount) * 0.0078787878 AS TREEVALUE FROM EG_DEVICEINFO I JOIN ( SELECT deviceid, SUM(cleancount) cleancount FROM EG_CLEANCOUNT GROUP BY deviceid ) C ON C.deviceid = I.deviceid JOIN EG_MANAGEGROUP M ON I.mangegroup = M.SN JOIN EG_USERINFO U ON U.USERID = #userid# WHERE M.UPCODE = U.MANAGEGROUP OR M.SN = U.MANAGEGROUP LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(DC) AS DEVICECOUNT , SUM(TC) AS CLEANCOUNT , SUM(Co2T) AS CO2VALUE , SUM(Tree) AS TREEVALUE FROM EG_DEVICEINFO I JOIN ( SELECT DEVICEID , 1 DC , SUM(C.cleancount) TC , SUM(C.cleancount) * 52 / 1000000 Co2T , SUM(C.cleancount) * 0.0078787878 Tree FROM EG_CLEANCOUNT C GROUP BY DEVICEID ) C ON C.deviceid = I.deviceid AND I.mangegroup > 0
SELECT '0' AS SN , '0' AS DEVICEID , '0' AS CLEANDATE , SUM(CLEANCOUNT) AS CLEANCOUNT FROM EG_CLEANCOUNT WHERE DEVICEID = #deviceid# LIMIT 1

SELECT DateSeries.Date AS INSTALLDATE, '' AS INSTALLNAME, '' AS DEVICEID, 0 AS DEVICECOUNT, COALESCE(SUM(c.cleancount), 0) AS CLEANCOUNT, COALESCE(SUM(c.cleancount), 0) * 52 / 1000000 AS CO2VALUE, COALESCE(SUM(c.cleancount), 0) * 0.0078787878 AS TREEVALUE, '' AS DEVICELIFE FROM ( SELECT CURRENT_DATE() AS Date UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 3 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 4 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 5 DAY UNION ALL SELECT CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY ) AS DateSeries LEFT JOIN eg_cleancount c ON DateSeries.Date = c.cleandate AND c.deviceid = #deviceid# LEFT JOIN eg_deviceinfo d ON c.deviceid = d.deviceid GROUP BY DateSeries.Date, d.devicename ORDER BY DateSeries.Date

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT I.deviceid) = 1 THEN STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(MAX(I.deviceid),8,8) , '%Y%m%d') ELSE '' END AS INSTALLDATE, CASE WHEN U.LEVEL = 0 THEN M2.GROUPNAME WHEN U.LEVEL = 1 THEN M.GROUPNAME ELSE I.DEVICENAME END AS INSTALLNAME, MAX(I.deviceid) AS DEVICEID, COUNT(DISTINCT I.deviceid) AS DEVICECOUNT, COALESCE(SUM(C.cleancount), 0) AS CLEANCOUNT, COALESCE(SUM(C.cleancount), 0) * 52 / 1000000 AS CO2VALUE, COALESCE(SUM(C.cleancount), 0) * 0.0078787878 AS TREEVALUE, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT I.deviceid) = 1 THEN CASE WHEN MAX(I.lastsignaldt) > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) THEN 'S' ELSE 'F' END ELSE '' END AS DEVICELIFE FROM EG_DEVICEINFO I LEFT JOIN ( SELECT deviceid, SUM(cleancount) cleancount FROM EG_CLEANCOUNT WHERE cleandate BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#startdate#, '%m/%d/%Y') AND STR_TO_DATE(#enddate#, '%m/%d/%Y') GROUP BY deviceid ) C ON I.deviceid = C.deviceid JOIN EG_MANAGEGROUP M ON I.mangegroup = M.SN LEFT JOIN EG_MANAGEGROUP M2 ON M.UPCODE = M2.SN JOIN EG_USERINFO U ON U.USERID = #userid# WHERE U.LEVEL = 0 OR ( (U.LEVEL = 1 AND U.MANAGEGROUP = M.UPCODE) OR (U.LEVEL = 2 AND U.MANAGEGROUP = M.SN) ) GROUP BY CASE WHEN U.LEVEL = 0 THEN M2.GROUPNAME WHEN U.LEVEL = 1 THEN M.GROUPNAME ELSE I.DEVICENAME END ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(C.cleancount), 0) DESC

sqlMap.update: UPDATE MGAME_RANKINGS SET SCORE = GREATEST( #score# , SCORE) , TOTALSCORE = GREATEST ( #totalscore# , TOTALSCORE) , UPDATETIME = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR) WHERE 1=1 AND GAMEGBN=#gamegbn# AND ID=#id# LIMIT 1

UPDATE MGAME_RANKINGS U , ( SELECT sn, score, id, ( @rank := @rank + 1 ) AS RANK, ( @real_rank := IF ( @last > score, @real_rank:=@real_rank+1, @real_rank ) ) AS REAL_RANK, ( @last := score ) FROM MGAME_RANKINGS AS a , ( SELECT @rank := 0, @last := 0, @real_rank := 1 ) AS b WHERE a.GAMEGBN = 'LGGM' ORDER BY a.score DESC ) R SET U.RANKING = R.REAL_RANK , U.SERIALRANKING = R.RANK WHERE U.ID = R.ID
sqlMap.select: SELECT SN, GAMEGBN , ID, SCORE , TOTALSCORE , RANKING FROM ( SELECT SN, GAMEGBN , ID, SCORE, TOTALSCORE , RANKING , SERIALRANKING , M.MYRANKING MYRANING, M.TOTAL TOTAL FROM MGAME_RANKINGS S , ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ID = #id# THEN SERIALRANKING ELSE 0 END) AS MYRANKING , COUNT(1) AS TOTAL FROM MGAME_RANKINGS ) M ORDER BY RANKING ) R WHERE GAMEGBN=#gamegbn# AND SERIALRANKING BETWEEN CASE WHEN (R.TOTAL - R.MYRANING) < 2 THEN R.MYRANING - 2 - (2 - (R.TOTAL - R.MYRANING)) ELSE R.MYRANING - 2 END AND CASE WHEN R.MYRANING > 2 THEN R.MYRANING + 2 ELSE R.MYRANING + 2 + ( 3 - R.MYRANING ) END LIMIT 5
